release.note: Archives are GitHub Release assets of the tag named in tools/wallpaper_profiles.py (RELEASE_TAG); the URL pattern is https://github.com/ncr/omarchy-p-bloom-theme/releases/download/<tag>/<archive>

readability.note: Smallest type on the native file after every transform. Lower resolutions are composed more compactly and drop secondary blocks; type is never shrunk.

encoding.note: Lossless intermediates are audited; shipped files are re-encoded.
